headline: Groß national product carries 123 39
deck: 123 39 edge test211 40-39, Groß's 14 the top score
body:
Fourteen from Groß did the settling. The midfielder was the biggest number on either side, and 123 39 needed every point of him, because behind that the returns thinned fast. Schade added ten up front, Haaland six, and a one-point win was built on the pair at the top and little else.

The floor is where 123 39 will look with relief. Stach three, B.Fernandes two, Neto two. Slim contributions, but in a margin of one they all counted.

test211 lost this by a single point and the defence is what will gnaw. Bogle led the side with twelve, Castagne added six, Aina two, three defenders returning and still not enough. João Pedro's nine up front was honest work with nobody alongside him, King and Enciso managing two apiece. One more point anywhere and the tie flips.
